column1: # Phase 4 — AIP observer coverage against the ATT&CK techniques exercised by
# the Atomic Red Team corpus (github.com/redcanaryco/atomic-red-team, MIT).
# This is a CAPABILITY map, not a run log. It states, per ATT&CK technique,
# which kernel primitive the AIP observer records for that technique and how
# strong the resulting attribution is. It does NOT claim each atomic was
# executed here: destructive techniques (T1070, T1222, T1485, ...) are NOT run
# on this host (safety rules 1/5). A "verdict" is only ever produced by
# executing and reconciling; where that has genuinely happened it is cited as
#   attributed      the observer records the primitive AND binds it to a
#   effect-observed the observer records the effect (socket/file) but
#                   attribution to a bound instance may be partial.
#   not-covered     no AIP sensor observes this technique's primitive. Stated
#                   plainly — an all-green map would be a lie (blocker B2).
#   reconciler-tests     covered by aip-reconcile / aip-observe test suites
#   reproduction-only    atomics/<ID>/ in the pinned corpus; NOT executed here
#   blind-spot           deliberately listed as not-covered; AIP's known limit
# columns: technique_id <TAB> tactic <TAB> name <TAB> aip_primitive <TAB> coverage_class <TAB> evidence
